sites.name: eLeaseReturns.com
sites.notes: Dealer Car Search platform (dealercarsearch.com assets, dealer id 3073) — confirmed by control fetch (SRP pages + one live VDP) that it emits zero schema.org Vehicle/ItemList JSON-LD anywhere, and VDP URLs use numeric internal ids (/vdp/{id}/...) not VINs, so our sitemap/VIN-prefilter + JSON-LD pipeline has no hook into this platform at all. A real discovery gap, not a bug: VIN is only recoverable via raw-HTML field scraping (scattered hidden form inputs), not one embedded blob like DDC/DealerOn/TeamVelocity, so a dedicated extractor would be substantial new work. Also: canonical link and robots.txt Sitemap: both point to leasereturns.com (no 'e' prefix) — eleasereturns.com looks like an alias domain serving identical content. Sampled current inventory (~2 dozen VDPs across SRP pages) shows no EVs in stock right now (BMW, Land Rover, other luxury ICE) — today's zero yield is doubly correct, but the platform gap would still miss any EV they do carry later.
